label: dense_pilot
method: Dense stationary raw-LiDAR reference (user-confirmed hold), 3.5 cm voxels and planar-neighbour normal filtering. Source scans 4.5 cm voxels with centroid point times; robust point-to-plane multiscale alignment. Initial guesses use only last accepted LiDAR pose; second perturbed initialization checks local consistency. No IMU or vendor pose/velocity guides registration.
limits: Reference stationarity assumed from user-confirmed motion sequence; small standing sway can broaden the reference.
Fixed initial-view reference may not cover scenes observed after large turns.
Full-scan intra-scan distortion and effective point-time uncertainty remain.
Quality gates reduce but cannot eliminate wrong matches.
